title: Third Bridge Launches Model Context Protocol for AI Research Workflows
summary: Third Bridge launched a Model Context Protocol (MCP) it describes as a platform-agnostic intelligence layer for the financial services ecosystem. The MCP makes Third Bridge's library of 100,000+ expert interview transcripts available inside leading large language models and specialist financial AI platforms, removing manual data movement between systems.
whyItMatters: Third Bridge's MCP extends its content-distribution strategy beyond named integrations (Anthropic, Aiera, Rogo, Samaya) into a standardized, platform-agnostic layer — making its transcript library reachable from virtually any AI environment a client chooses.
